p_1.label: Paragraph — Information about your details when you browse our website o
p_1.value: Information about your details when you browse our website or contact us about a trade inquiry.

p_3.label: Paragraph — This policy covers the Parthvi Exim website and inquiries di
p_3.value: This policy covers the Parthvi Exim website and inquiries directed to Parthvi Exim, Surat, Gujarat, India.

p_4.label: Paragraph — When you contact us, you may provide your name, email addres
p_4.value: When you contact us, you may provide your name, email address, phone number, country, company name, product interest, quantity, and other trade requirements. Please share only details relevant to your inquiry, and avoid sending passwords, payment card details, or unnecessary identity documents.

p_5.label: Paragraph — When you submit the website inquiry form, your details are s
p_5.value: When you submit the website inquiry form, your details are saved in our inquiry system and are available to our authorized administrator for follow-up. You can also contact us directly by email, telephone, or WhatsApp.

p_6.label: Paragraph — Information provided with an inquiry is used to respond to y
p_6.value: Information provided with an inquiry is used to respond to you, clarify product requirements, prepare quotations, and coordinate requested business communications. If an inquiry leads to a transaction, additional details may be needed for invoicing, documentation, and shipment arrangements.

p_7.label: Paragraph — Email and communication providers process messages through t
p_7.value: Email and communication providers process messages through their services. Where needed to fulfill a transaction, relevant details may also be shared with logistics, documentation, or professional service providers, or disclosed where required by applicable law.

p_8.label: Paragraph — This website does not currently include advertising trackers
p_8.value: This website does not currently include advertising trackers, analytics scripts, buyer accounts, or an online checkout. Essential session cookies protect the inquiry form and admin sign-in. Styling and navigation resources are served with the website. Hosting systems may maintain technical access logs for operation and security.

p_9.label: Paragraph — Links to WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn take yo
p_9.value: Links to WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn take you to external services. Those services and your email provider handle information under their own privacy policies and may use cookies or similar technologies. You can manage cookies through your browser settings.

p_10.label: Paragraph — Website inquiries are kept in the inquiry system for follow-
p_10.value: Website inquiries are kept in the inquiry system for follow-up and can be removed by the administrator. Inquiry and business correspondence may also remain in email or messaging records for transaction documentation and applicable record-keeping requirements. The appropriate retention period depends on the nature of the correspondence and any resulting transaction.

p_11.label: Paragraph — No internet or email service can guarantee absolute security
p_11.value: No internet or email service can guarantee absolute security. Contact us if you believe information shared with us has been accessed or used improperly.

p_12.label: Paragraph — You can browse without completing an inquiry. Review your de
p_12.value: You can browse without completing an inquiry. Review your details before submitting the contact form. You can contact us to request access to, correction of, or deletion of information you have shared, or to ask us to stop further inquiry follow-up.

p_13.label: Paragraph — We may need to verify a request and retain records required
p_13.value: We may need to verify a request and retain records required for an existing transaction or by applicable law. The availability of particular rights depends on the laws that apply to your circumstances.

p_14.label: Paragraph — This policy may be updated as the website or our services ch
p_14.value: This policy may be updated as the website or our services change. The date above identifies the latest revision.

p_1.label: Paragraph — Please read these terms when using our website and making a
p_1.value: Please read these terms when using our website and making a trade inquiry.

p_3.label: Paragraph — This website is provided by Parthvi Exim, Surat, Gujarat, In
p_3.value: This website is provided by Parthvi Exim, Surat, Gujarat, India, to introduce our agricultural products and help prospective buyers contact us. These terms concern use of the website; individual transactions require separately agreed commercial terms.

p_4.label: Paragraph — You may browse the website, review product information, down
p_4.value: You may browse the website, review product information, download certificates for legitimate business review, and contact us with inquiries. Please provide accurate contact details and only share information you are authorized to provide.

p_5.label: Paragraph — Do not misuse the website, attempt unauthorized access, dist
p_5.value: Do not misuse the website, attempt unauthorized access, distribute malicious content, impersonate another person or business, or use our information in a misleading or unlawful way.

p_6.label: Paragraph — Product descriptions, photographs, grades, packaging options
p_6.value: Product descriptions, photographs, grades, packaging options, and specifications provide general information. Natural agricultural products may vary between batches. Availability, exact specifications, quantities, and packaging must be confirmed for each order.

p_7.label: Paragraph — Descriptions of product applications are for general commerc
p_7.value: Descriptions of product applications are for general commercial information and are not medical advice or a guarantee of suitability for a particular use. Buyers should confirm the requirements for their intended application and destination market.

p_8.label: Paragraph — The website does not accept payments or place orders. Sendin
p_8.value: The website does not accept payments or place orders. Sending the contact form saves your requirements for our team to review. An inquiry, downloaded document, or website visit does not create a confirmed purchase or supply agreement.

p_9.label: Paragraph — Prices, payment arrangements, product specifications, inspec
p_9.value: Prices, payment arrangements, product specifications, inspection requirements, delivery schedules, shipping responsibilities, and any cancellation, return, or refund terms must be agreed in writing for the relevant transaction. Please obtain confirmation before making payment or relying on a delivery date.

p_10.label: Paragraph — Any separately agreed transaction terms govern that transact
p_10.value: Any separately agreed transaction terms govern that transaction. These website terms do not replace them or exclude rights that cannot lawfully be excluded.

p_11.label: Paragraph — The Parthvi Exim name, logo, and website materials must not
p_11.value: The Parthvi Exim name, logo, and website materials must not be used to imply an unauthorized partnership or endorsement. Do not alter certificates or reproduce them in a way that misrepresents their holder, scope, or status.

p_12.label: Paragraph — Certificates are provided for reference and business verific
p_12.value: Certificates are provided for reference and business verification. A registration or license is not a guarantee of every product, shipment, or intended use. If current documentation is needed, contact us and verify relevant details with the issuing authority.

p_13.label: Paragraph — Social media, WhatsApp, email, and other external services o
p_13.value: Social media, WhatsApp, email, and other external services operate under their own terms and policies. We do not control their content, availability, or operation.

p_14.label: Paragraph — We may revise these website terms as information or services
p_14.value: We may revise these website terms as information or services change. The latest revision date is shown above. Changes to these website terms do not automatically change an existing written transaction agreement.
